directories.packages/core/src/primitives: Generic UI wrappers with no schema knowledge. Imports only React.
directories.packages/core/src/engine: Schema parsing, validation, and rendering. Imports Layer 1 only.
directories.packages/core/src/engine/context: React context for injecting shadcn primitives into engine renderers.
directories.packages/core/src/engine/helpers: Utility functions: i18n, immutability, branded type helpers.
directories.packages/core/src/engine/renderers: React renderers that consume schemas via PrimitivesContext.
directories.packages/core/src/engine/types: All schema type definitions (one per file). Pure TS, no runtime deps.
directories.packages/core/src/engine/validators: Zod schemas and runtime validation functions.
directories.apps/showcase/src: Showcase app entry point. TanStack Start file-based routing.
directories.apps/showcase/src/app: App-level providers (primitives context, query client, theme)
directories.apps/showcase/src/data: Mock schema definitions and static data for showcase demos
directories.apps/showcase/src/routes: TanStack Start file-based routes for showcase app pages and demos
directories.apps/showcase/src/server: Server functions for data fetching (TanStack Start createServerFn).
directories.apps/showcase/src/stores: Zustand state stores for demo data (users, orders, form schemas)
